name: Layouts | A field label rename is saved even though the layout editor says "Layout not saved"
description_html:
Summary

In the ticket layout editor, renaming a field label and clicking Save can show “Layout not saved” while the new label is in fact saved. The admin is told nothing was saved when part of the change was.

Steps to Reproduce

  1. Sign in as an admin and go to Setup › Modules & Fields › Tickets › Layouts.
  2. Open the Standard layout. It cannot be saved at the moment because of the related bug, which makes the failed save easy to see.
  3. On the Create tab, click a field label (in the recording, the Email field labelled “test”), type a new name (“Email”) and press Enter.
  4. Click Save. The message “Layout not saved: …” appears.
  5. Go to Setup › Modules & Fields › Tickets › Fields and search for the field.

Expected Result

  • If the layout cannot be saved, nothing is saved, including the label.
  • Or, if the label is kept, the message says that the label was saved and the layout was not.

Actual Result

  • The editor says “Layout not saved”.
  • The Fields list shows the field with its new label “Email”, so the rename was saved.
  • For about an hour afterwards the layout editor still showed the old label “test” on the Create tab, then it changed to “Email” without anyone saving the layout.

Related

  • Related bug: Saving a ticket layout replaces its Detail view with the Create view (the reason this save failed). This bug still applies whenever a layout save fails for any reason.

Environment

  • App: TAVI Desk, staging (staging-desk.taviportal.com), organization NDC-Staging
  • Page: Setup › Modules & Fields › Tickets › Layouts › Standard
  • Browser: Edge 156 on Windows 10, 1272×866
  • Reporter: ndc-staging-owner (Jam recorded 8 Nov 2026, 08:50 UTC); checked again 8 Nov 2026
